title.zh-TW: Vertex 支援快速模式，全球與美歐區域遭拒時退回標準速度備援
title.en: Vertex Supports Fast Mode, Falling Back to Standard Speed in Global, US, and EU Regions When Refused

body.zh-TW: 當你請 Claude 整理長篇技術文件或規劃專案架構時，等待模型生成內容的時間往往直接影響工作步調。現在這項工具在 Vertex（Google 旗下的雲端託管平台）正式加入快速模式。⟦跟搭乘商辦大樓的直達特快電梯一樣，以前專用電梯一旦拒載，乘客只能在閘門前被退回重新排隊；現在動線會自動換走每層皆停的一般電梯，行程絕不中斷。⟧這項設定目前已在 global 全球、us 美國與 eu 歐洲三個服務區域開放。Vertex 若拒絕快速模式，就退回標準速度。
body.en: When you ask Claude to organize long technical documents or plan project architecture, waiting for the model to generate content often directly affects your working pace. This tool now officially adds fast mode on Vertex (Google's managed cloud platform). ⟦Much like riding a direct express elevator in an office building, if the dedicated elevator previously refused boarding, passengers were turned away at the gate to line up all over again; now traffic automatically switches to a standard elevator that stops on every floor, ensuring the trip is never interrupted.⟧ This setting is currently available across three service regions: global, us, and eu. If Vertex refuses fast mode, it falls back to standard speed.

items.original: Added fast mode on Vertex in the global, us and eu regions, falling back to standard speed if Vertex refuses it

title.zh-TW: 代理人指揮中心標記未讀結果，切換後端工作階段保留草稿
title.en: Agent command center marks unread results, and switching backend sessions preserves drafts

body.zh-TW: 平時如果習慣讓多個助理分頭調查專案，終端機現在能讓你清楚掌握每位幫手的最新進度。執行 `codex agents --no-daemon` 就能打開代理人指揮中心，指揮中心與終端機工作階段（session，正在進行中的對話作業）選取器現在都會主動標記出未讀的執行結果。⟦猶如總機櫃台的分機信箱，信件送達時格子會亮起提示燈，即使轉身前往另一張辦公桌交涉，手中寫到一半的便箋也不會遺失。⟧當你在工作階段選取器中切換不同的已連線後端時，輸入框中還沒送出的草稿會完整保留下來，不會因為更換後端就遭到清空。
body.en: If you regularly have several assistants investigate different parts of a project, the terminal now makes it easier to keep track of each helper’s latest progress. Run `codex agents --no-daemon` to open the agent command center. Both the command center and the terminal session picker (for ongoing conversations) now mark unread results. ⟦Like extension mailboxes at a switchboard desk, a compartment lights up when mail arrives, and even if you turn to another desk to discuss something, the note you are halfway through writing stays with you.⟧ When you switch between connected backends in the session picker, any unsent draft in the input box stays intact instead of being cleared.

items.original:
Open the agent command center with `codex agents --no-daemon`. The command center and session picker now mark unread results (#58238, #58239, #58263, #58264).
Switch between connected backends from the terminal session picker and keep your drafts when switching (#58280, #58457).

title.zh-TW: 終端機輸入框即時預覽附加圖片，逐字稿路徑支援點擊開啟
title.en: Preview attached images in the terminal input box and click transcript paths to open them

body.zh-TW: 在終端機請模型排查版面外觀或分析架構圖時，最怕挑錯要送出的圖檔。現在只要使用支援的終端機，在輸入框撰寫內容時就能直接預覽附加的本機圖片。⟦彷彿在公文夾附上拍立得縮圖，夾上檔案的當下就能先瞄一眼畫面確認無誤，事後查閱歸檔清單時也能隨手按壓標籤快速調閱原圖。⟧而在對話逐字稿（transcript，記錄完整互動內容的文字檔）中，顯示的本機圖片路徑現在也支援點擊，輕點路徑就能直接開啟剛剛檢視過的圖片。
body.en: When asking a model in the terminal to troubleshoot a layout or analyze an architecture diagram, choosing the wrong image to send is a particular concern. On supported terminals, you can now preview attached local images directly while composing in the input box. ⟦Picture attaching a Polaroid thumbnail to a document folder: you can glance at the image as soon as you attach the file to check that it is right, then press its label while reviewing the archive list later to quickly retrieve the original image.⟧ Local image paths shown in the conversation transcript (a text file recording the full interaction) are now clickable too. Click a path to open the image you just viewed.

items.original: Preview local image attachments while composing on supported terminals, and open viewed local images from clickable transcript paths (#58261, #58446).

title.zh-TW: 登入選單支援 Vertex AI 設定精靈，切換模型提供者仍可查閱舊紀錄
title.en: Sign-in menu supports a Vertex AI setup wizard, and old chats remain accessible after switching providers

body.zh-TW: 需要連線到不同雲端平台調用模型時，設定登入與管理既有紀錄往往讓人傷腦筋。在「以其他方式登入（Sign in another way）」選單中，可以找到 API 金鑰與雲端提供者選項。只要啟用 `gcp_setup_wizard` 設定項，就能透過引導精靈以應用程式預設憑證（ADC，Google Cloud 用來自動驗證身分的機制）或憑證檔，串接 Google Cloud Vertex AI。⟦如同聘請不同事務所的顧問，櫃台提供制式表單幫你快速登記授權，而先前與上一家顧問往來的會議備忘錄依舊留在手邊，就算無法直接續約也能抄錄結論另開新專案。⟧切換模型提供者後，先前儲存的聊天紀錄依然會留在清單中。如果舊對話無法直接繼續執行，你也可以隨時閱讀歷史逐字稿，並把重點整理成可編輯的提示詞，在全新聊天中直接接續工作。
body.en: When connecting to different cloud platforms to use models, setting up sign-in and managing existing records can be a headache. You can find API key and cloud provider options under the “Sign in another way” menu. Enable `gcp_setup_wizard` to connect to Google Cloud Vertex AI through a guided wizard using Application Default Credentials (Google Cloud’s mechanism for automatically authenticating your identity) or a credential file. ⟦Think of hiring consultants from different firms: the front desk supplies standard forms to quickly register your authorization, while meeting notes from your previous consultants remain at hand, so even if you cannot renew the engagement directly, you can copy the conclusions into a new project.⟧ After you switch model providers, previously saved chats remain in the list. If an old conversation cannot resume directly, you can still read its historical transcript and turn the key points into an editable prompt to continue working in a new chat.

items.original:
Find API key and cloud provider options under “Sign in another way.” Enable `gcp_setup_wizard` to set up Google Cloud Vertex AI with Application Default Credentials or a credential file (#57857, #58427).
Saved chats stay visible after you switch model providers. If a chat can’t resume, you can read its transcript and prepare an editable prompt to continue in a new chat (#58202).

title.zh-TW: 審批提示下可展開修補細節，清螢幕保留紀錄且退格不跳指令模式
title.en: Expand patch details during approval, clear the screen while keeping history, and backspace without entering command mode

body.zh-TW:
在終端機審查程式碼修改並輸入回應時，細節檢視與打字體驗迎來了一批順手改進。

跳出審批提示（approval prompt）時，你現在能直接在對話逐字稿中展開修補程式細節。

在終端機整理畫面時，按下 `Ctrl+L` 會清空螢幕顯示內容，先前的對話訊息依然隨時能透過 `Ctrl+T` 叫出查閱。

在輸入框退格刪除文字時，就算露出開頭的驚嘆號 `!`，草稿依然會維持一般對話模式，不再被誤觸成執行外部指令的模式。
body.en:
Reviewing code changes and typing responses in the terminal now comes with several improvements to detail viewing and typing.

While an approval prompt is open, you can now expand patch details directly in the conversation transcript.

When tidying up the terminal view, pressing `Ctrl+L` clears the screen display. Earlier conversation messages remain available through `Ctrl+T` whenever you want to review them.

When backspacing in the input box exposes a leading exclamation mark `!`, the draft stays in ordinary chat mode instead of accidentally switching to the mode for running external commands.

items.original:
Expand patch details directly in the transcript while an approval prompt is open (#58281).
`Ctrl+L` clears the terminal display while keeping earlier messages available through `Ctrl+T` (#58266).
Deleting text that exposes a leading `!` keeps an ordinary draft in chat mode (#58412).

title.zh-TW: 支援系統網路代理設定，網路請求逐一排隊審批並明定權限規範
title.en: System proxy settings supported, network approvals queued individually, and permission rules documented

body.zh-TW:
在需要透過特定通道連線或對外部請求有嚴密資安管制的環境中，網路連線行為現在更容易掌握。

現在輸入 `/experimental` 就能選擇加入 macOS 或 Windows 的系統代理伺服器（proxy，協助轉發網路封包的中繼伺服器）設定，讓工具連線直接遵循作業系統的網路轉發規則。

遇到需要手動核准的網路連線時，網路審批提示會在請求結束時自動關閉。多個連往同一個端點的並行請求也不會再同時跳出干擾，而是依序逐一跳出提示讓你確認。

應用程式伺服器（app-server）的說明文件中，也正式補齊了設定檔 `[permissions.network]` 底下的受控網路限制說明，並明列了哪些 `prompt-user` 指令規則必須取得最新的人工審批才能放行。
body.en:
In environments that require connections through specific channels or tightly control external requests for security, network connection behavior is now easier to keep track of.

Enter `/experimental` to opt into macOS or Windows system proxy settings (relay servers that help forward network packets), so tool connections directly follow the operating system’s network forwarding rules.

For network connections that require manual approval, the network approval prompt now closes automatically when the request ends. Concurrent requests to the same endpoint no longer interrupt you with simultaneous prompts. Instead, prompts appear one at a time for you to confirm.

The app-server (application server) documentation now also covers managed network constraints under `[permissions.network]` in the configuration file and explicitly lists which `prompt-user` command rules require fresh human approval before they can proceed.

items.original:
Opt into macOS or Windows system proxy settings from `/experimental` (#58157).
Network approval prompts close when their requests end. Concurrent requests to the same endpoint prompt one at a time (#58350, #58351).
The app-server README covers managed network constraints under `[permissions.network]` and `prompt-user` command rules that require fresh human approval (#58045, #58182).

title.zh-TW: Realtime V3 語音自動存入對話歷史，上下文壓縮納入失敗回應產出
title.en: Realtime V3 speech saves automatically to chat history, and context compaction counts output from failed responses

body.zh-TW: 當你進行長時間的即時對話或複雜的多輪問答時，對話內容的完整記錄與記憶管理至關重要。在長期的 Realtime V3 即時語音對話中，隨著逐字稿長度增長，工具會即時將已結束的語音內容保存至聊天歷史記錄中。⟦好比速記員一邊開會一邊將說完的發言謄進議事錄，管帳人員在打包過長卷宗時，也會把印壞的草稿和漏蓋計費章的廢頁通通算入紙張重量。⟧在對話長度過長觸發自動上下文壓縮時，計算機制現在也會如實算入執行失敗回應留下的輸出，以及缺少 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）用量數據的回應。
body.en: When you have long real-time conversations or complex exchanges with multiple rounds of questions and answers, complete conversation records and memory management are essential. During long Realtime V3 voice conversations, the tool saves completed speech to chat history as the transcript grows. ⟦Imagine a stenographer transcribing completed remarks into the minutes as a meeting proceeds, while the bookkeeper packing up overly long files counts misprinted drafts and discarded pages missing billing stamps toward the total paper weight.⟧ When a conversation gets long enough to trigger automatic context compaction, the calculation now also counts retained output from failed responses and responses missing token usage data (the text units AI processes and bills for).

items.original:
Long realtime V3 conversations save completed speech to chat history as the transcript grows (#58221).
Automatic context compaction now accounts for retained output from failed responses and responses with missing token usage data (#58404).

title.zh-TW: 淘汰模型主動推薦替代方案，Linux musl 降低閒置記憶體佔用
title.en: Retiring models get replacement recommendations, and Linux musl reduces idle memory use

body.zh-TW:
開發者在維護長期專案或將工具部署在輕量環境時，模型升級與底層資源消耗現在都有更省心的安排。

如果正在使用的模型即將淘汰，內建的 `openai-docs` 技能（skill，擴充 AI 能力的指引包）在引導遷移時，會直接根據官方文件推薦合適的替代模型。

針對安裝部署，DotSlash（按平台自動下載對應執行檔的發布工具）的設定清單現在會直接參照本次版本隨附發布的 Cargo 套件。

若是在 Linux musl 環境編譯，底層改用較少的記憶體配置區（allocator arenas，底層向系統申請記憶體的緩衝區塊），有效降低對話工作階段卸載之後殘留的閒置記憶體。
body.en:
For developers maintaining long-running projects or deploying tools in lightweight environments, model upgrades and underlying resource use now require less attention.

If the model you are using is being retired, the built-in `openai-docs` skill (a package of instructions that extends AI capabilities) now recommends a suitable replacement directly from the official documentation when guiding migration.

For installation and deployment, DotSlash (a tool that downloads the right executable for each platform) manifests now directly reference the Cargo packages shipped with this release.

Builds for Linux musl now use fewer allocator arenas (buffer blocks used to request memory from the system), reducing idle memory left behind after conversation sessions unload.

items.original:
The `openai-docs` skill recommends the documented replacement when migrating away from a deprecated model (#58134).
DotSlash manifests now reference the Cargo packages shipped with the release (#58717, #58757).
Linux musl builds use fewer allocator arenas to reduce idle memory after conversations unload (#58399).

entries: Added swarms as a preview: start one with `/swarm <task>` and the agent becomes a coordinator that adds worker agents, each in its own conversation, which work on the task in parallel and collaborate through a shared message board; workers can be forked from an existing member's conversation, run on any model in the `/model` picker, and pause instead of retrying when their model runs out of quota, and a monitor worker alerts the coordinator when the whole swarm stalls. `/swarm` is labeled `(Preview & Quota Heavy)` in the `/` menu because every worker is a separate agent that uses your quota.

Added `/swarm board`, a full-screen live view of the current swarm that also opens with `alt+s` (rebindable as `swarm.board`), with a `Roster` of members showing each one's state and model, a `Posts` feed, and a `Message` pane that renders the selected post as Markdown; `tab` and `shift+tab` move between panes, `z` zooms the focused pane, `enter` shows or hides the message, `[` and `]` step through posts, `p` filters the feed to one member's posts and the posts that mention them, `o` opens a member's subagent details, `f` follows new posts, and `esc` backs out.

Added a `● Swarm(<title>)` row to the active-items tray below the prompt while a swarm runs, showing the latest post and the post count and then `Done` when the swarm finishes; press `Enter` on the row to open `/swarm board`, or `alt+x` (`swarm.dismiss`) to dismiss it.

Added the `ANTIGRAVITY_DISABLE_EMBEDDED_RIPGREP` environment variable, which you can set to `true` to stop the CLI from extracting and running its bundled `ripgrep`, for example when endpoint security software blocks it, so searches use a `ripgrep` on your `PATH` or the built-in search instead.
Added Gemini 4 Carbon (Low, Medium, and High) to `/model` and `--model` when you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`).

Changed enterprise model gateway URLs to require `https://` unless the gateway runs on the same machine (`localhost`, `127.0.0.0/8`, or `::1`); a remote gateway configured with a plain `http://` URL is now rejected with an error instead of receiving your prompts unencrypted.

Fixed `agy plugin import` turning Claude Code plugin commands into skills that did not load or were all named `SKILL`; each command now becomes a skill named after its folder, including commands with no frontmatter or with Claude Code-style values such as `argument-hint: [base branch] [focus]`, and `agy plugin validate` no longer warns about the leftover `commands/` folder.

Fixed `agy plugin import` copying certain plugin's `hooks/hooks.json` unchanged, which caused the plugin's hooks to be skipped; `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `Stop`, and startup `SessionStart` hooks are now converted, with tool names in matchers mapped to built-in tools (for example `Bash` to `run_command`) and a default 60-second timeout, and hooks with no equivalent are listed as warnings in the import summary.

Fixed `agy -p` headless runs sometimes never exiting after printing their result when a background task, such as conversation title generation, got stuck; the CLI now finishes shutting down within 30 seconds.

Fixed `/teamwork` writing run state into `.agents/teamwork/` in your working directory, where two runs in the same workspace could overwrite each other; each run now keeps its state in its own folder under the CLI's app data directory.

Fixed links to files in agent responses showing only the file name, which made the file's location impossible to tell in terminals that cannot open clickable links, such as Terminal.app, `screen`, or over SSH; labels now show the path relative to your working directory, relative to `~/`, or the absolute path.
Fixed enterprise model gateways that validate the request format rejecting every request, because the CLI sent a non-standard `sessionId` field in Gemini-format requests.

Fixed subagents and swarm workers that get their own copy of a Git repository starting from the last commit and losing your uncommitted work; their worktree now includes your staged, unstaged, and untracked changes, and agents outside version control can give a subagent or worker an isolated copy of the workspace folder, for folders up to 100,000 entries and 4 GiB.

title.zh-TW: /swarm 預覽版支援多代理人協作，透過共享看板分工推進任務
title.en: Preview /swarm supports multi-agent collaboration to advance tasks through a shared board

body.zh-TW: 面對大型架構重構或跨模組調查時，只靠單一對話往往得排隊等待 AI 一步步執行。現在輸入 `/swarm <任務>` 就能開啟預覽版蜂群模式。主要代理人會轉為協調員，在各自獨立的工作階段中加入多位工作代理人，彼此透過共享留言板平行處理工作。工作代理人可以從既有成員的對話衍生分支，並自由選用 `/model` 選單裡的任何模型。遇到模型額度用盡時，工作代理人會暫停作業而非持續重試。要是整組蜂群陷入停擺，監控代理人會主動向協調員發出警示。由於每位工作代理人都是獨立運作並消耗額度，因此斜線選單上特別標記為 `(Preview & Quota Heavy)`。⟦跟研發專案指派多組小組分頭調查一樣，以前一人卡關進度就中斷；現在各組在公佈欄留言同步情報，碰上材料短缺先原地待命，監工發現全線停工也會通報主持主管。⟧
body.en: When facing large architecture refactors or cross-module investigations, relying on a single conversation often means waiting in line as the AI executes step by step. You can now enter `/swarm <task>` to launch the preview swarm mode. The primary agent becomes a coordinator that adds multiple worker agents, each in its own independent session, working on tasks in parallel through a shared message board. Worker agents can be forked from an existing member's conversation and freely use any model from the `/model` picker. When a model runs out of quota, worker agents pause instead of repeatedly retrying. If the entire swarm stalls, a monitor agent alerts the coordinator. Because each worker agent operates independently and consumes quota, it is specifically marked as `(Preview & Quota Heavy)` in the slash menu. ⟦Just as an R&D project assigns multiple teams to investigate separately, previously progress halted whenever one person got stuck; now each team syncs updates on a bulletin board, stays on standby when materials run low, and an overseer alerts the lead manager if all work stalls.⟧

items.original: Added swarms as a preview: start one with `/swarm <task>` and the agent becomes a coordinator that adds worker agents, each in its own conversation, which work on the task in parallel and collaborate through a shared message board; workers can be forked from an existing member's conversation, run on any model in the `/model` picker, and pause instead of retrying when their model runs out of quota, and a monitor worker alerts the coordinator when the whole swarm stalls. `/swarm` is labeled `(Preview & Quota Heavy)` in the `/` menu because every worker is a separate agent that uses your quota.

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕看板與狀態列掌握 Swarm 進度，支援快捷鍵即時監控
title.en: Track Swarm progress with full-screen board and status row, featuring shortcut keys for live monitoring

body.zh-TW:
當背景有多位代理人同時運作時，隨時掌握各成員的發言與進展至關重要。蜂群運作期間，輸入框下方的作用中項目系統匣會顯示 `● Swarm(<標題>)` 列，即時呈現最新留言與發文總數，完成時標記為 `Done`。你可以在該列按 `Enter` 開啟 `/swarm board` 全螢幕看板，或按 `alt+x` 關閉提示列（可自訂為 `swarm.dismiss`）。平常也能隨時按 `alt+s` 叫出看板（可自訂為 `swarm.board`）。看板分為成員名單（呈現各成員狀態與模型）、貼文牆與 Markdown 預覽窗格，並支援完整導覽按鍵：

```
tab / shift+tab # 在各窗格間切換
z               # 放大目前聚焦的窗格
enter           # 展開或隱藏選取的訊息
[ / ]           # 上下逐篇瀏覽貼文
p               # 篩選特定成員的貼文與標記提及
o               # 開啟成員的子代理人詳細資訊
f               # 自動跟隨最新發布的貼文
esc             # 返回前一個畫面
```

⟦好比戰情室監控多組外勤任務，以前只能盯著終端機逐行盲猜動態；現在主螢幕分割呈現人員狀態與通報細節，手邊儀表板也能快速展開追蹤。⟧
body.en:
When multiple agents run simultaneously in the background, keeping track of every member's updates and progress is essential. While a swarm runs, a `● Swarm(<title>)` row appears in the active-items tray below the prompt, displaying the latest message and total post count, and marking `Done` when finished. You can press `Enter` on that row to open the `/swarm board` full-screen board, or press `alt+x` to dismiss the row (rebindable as `swarm.dismiss`). You can also press `alt+s` at any time to bring up the board (rebindable as `swarm.board`). The board is divided into a roster (showing each member's state and model), a posts feed, and a Markdown preview pane, supporting full navigation keys:

```
tab / shift+tab # Move between panes
z               # Zoom the focused pane
enter           # Show or hide the selected message
[ / ]           # Step up and down through posts
p               # Filter posts to a specific member and mentions
o               # Open a member's subagent details
f               # Follow new posts automatically
esc             # Back out to the previous screen
```

⟦Picture a situation room monitoring multiple field missions: operators once stared at terminal lines blindly guessing what was happening; now a split screen displays personnel status alongside report details, and a handy dashboard opens quickly for tracking.⟧

items.original:
Added `/swarm board`, a full-screen live view of the current swarm that also opens with `alt+s` (rebindable as `swarm.board`), with a `Roster` of members showing each one's state and model, a `Posts` feed, and a `Message` pane that renders the selected post as Markdown; `tab` and `shift+tab` move between panes, `z` zooms the focused pane, `enter` shows or hides the message, `[` and `]` step through posts, `p` filters the feed to one member's posts and the posts that mention them, `o` opens a member's subagent details, `f` follows new posts, and `esc` backs out.
Added a `● Swarm(<title>)` row to the active-items tray below the prompt while a swarm runs, showing the latest post and the post count and then `Done` when the swarm finishes; press `Enter` on the row to open `/swarm board`, or `alt+x` (`swarm.dismiss`) to dismiss it.

title.zh-TW: 新增環境變數停用內建 ripgrep，避開端點防護軟體攔截
title.en: Add environment variable to disable bundled ripgrep and avoid endpoint protection blocks

body.zh-TW: 在受企業資安管控的電腦上搜尋程式碼時，防毒軟體常會把工具臨時解壓縮出來的執行檔當成威脅阻擋。環境變數現在新增了 `ANTIGRAVITY_DISABLE_EMBEDDED_RIPGREP`。只要將它設為 `true`，指令列工具就不會再解壓縮並執行隨附的 `ripgrep` 搜尋工具。這項設定專為終端安全防護軟體阻擋內建工具的情境設計。啟用後，搜尋流程會改用系統環境變數 `PATH` 中已安裝的 `ripgrep`，或是直接使用內建搜尋機制。⟦宛如攜帶專用工具組進入管制廠區，以前保全會扣留臨時拆封的隨身器具導致作業中斷；現在允許直接登記使用廠內合格的常駐設備，不用再強行解封。⟧
body.en: When searching code on machines subject to corporate security policies, antivirus software often blocks temporary executables extracted by tools as threats. A new environment variable, `ANTIGRAVITY_DISABLE_EMBEDDED_RIPGREP`, is now available. Setting it to `true` stops the command-line tool from extracting and executing the bundled `ripgrep` search utility. This setting is specifically designed for situations where endpoint security software blocks embedded tools. Once enabled, searches use a `ripgrep` installed on your system `PATH` or fall back to the built-in search mechanism. ⟦Think of bringing a specialized toolkit into a restricted facility: security once confiscated newly unpacked personal gear and halted operations; now technicians may check out pre-approved resident equipment instead of unsealing fresh tools.⟧

items.original: Added the `ANTIGRAVITY_DISABLE_EMBEDDED_RIPGREP` environment variable, which you can set to `true` to stop the CLI from extracting and running its bundled `ripgrep`, for example when endpoint security software blocks it, so searches use a `ripgrep` on your `PATH` or the built-in search instead.

title.zh-TW: 支援應用程式預設憑證使用 Gemini 4 Carbon，提供 Low、Medium、High 三個版本
title.en: Support Gemini 4 Carbon via Application Default Credentials across Low, Medium, and High tiers

body.zh-TW: 如果你用 Google Cloud 憑證登入開發環境，想換個模型試試，現在多了新選擇。只要透過應用程式預設憑證（`AGY_ADC_AUTH`）登入，`/model` 選單與啟動參數 `--model` 都會出現 Gemini 4 Carbon，並提供 Low、Medium、High 三個版本。想指定其中一個，就在選單裡挑，或在啟動時加上 `--model` 並帶入對應的版本名稱。⟦就像專業維修廠的工具櫃裡多放了三把規格不同的扳手，以前走這條憑證通道只能用原本那幾把；現在多了三個選項可選，想用哪一把自己決定。⟧
body.en: If you sign in to your development environment with Google Cloud credentials and want to try another model, you now have a new option. When signing in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`), Gemini 4 Carbon appears in both the `/model` picker and the `--model` startup parameter across Low, Medium, and High tiers. To specify one, select it from the menu or pass `--model` with the corresponding tier name at launch. ⟦A professional repair shop adds three wrenches of different sizes to its tool cabinet: previously, accessing the cabinet through this credential channel offered only the original tools; now three extra options are available, letting technicians choose whichever fits.⟧

items.original: Added Gemini 4 Carbon (Low, Medium, and High) to `/model` and `--model` when you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`).

title.zh-TW: 企業模型閘道強制加密連線，並修復 Gemini 格式請求欄位
title.en: Enforce encrypted connections for enterprise model gateways and fix Gemini request fields

body.zh-TW: 企業內部通常會架設專屬閘道轉發 AI 請求，以落實資料治理並稽核傳輸內容。設定遠端企業模型閘道網址時，現在一律強制使用 `https://` 加密連線。除非閘道位在同一台主機上（例如 `localhost`、`127.0.0.0/8` 或 `::1`），否則若設定為未加密的 `http://` 網址，工具會直接拒絕並回報錯誤，不再以明文送出提示詞。過去向企業閘道發送 Gemini 格式的請求時，工具會附帶非標準的 `sessionId` 欄位，導致嚴格檢查格式的閘道拒絕所有請求。這個格式問題已經修好。⟦如同企業內部設置機密公文傳送管道，以前允許明信片平信投遞且封條格式不符會被退回；現在遠端傳送一律強制密封掛號，信件代碼也改用標準規範封存。⟧
body.en: Enterprises commonly set up dedicated gateways to forward AI requests to enforce data governance and audit transmitted content. When configuring a remote enterprise model gateway URL, the CLI now strictly requires an encrypted `https://` connection. Unless the gateway runs on the same machine (such as `localhost`, `127.0.0.0/8`, or `::1`), configuring an unencrypted `http://` URL is rejected with an error rather than sending prompts in plain text. In the past, sending Gemini-format requests to enterprise gateways included a non-standard `sessionId` field, causing gateways that strictly validate request formats to reject every request. This formatting issue has been fixed. ⟦Consider a secure courier dispatch system for sensitive documents: unsealed postcards were once permitted and irregular envelope stamps caused outright rejections; now remote dispatches mandate sealed certified mail while letter codes follow standard specifications.⟧

items.original:
Changed enterprise model gateway URLs to require `https://` unless the gateway runs on the same machine (`localhost`, `127.0.0.0/8`, or `::1`); a remote gateway configured with a plain `http://` URL is now rejected with an error instead of receiving your prompts unencrypted.
Fixed enterprise model gateways that validate the request format rejecting every request, because the CLI sent a non-standard `sessionId` field in Gemini-format requests.

title.zh-TW: 匯入 Claude Code 外掛自動轉換指令與掛鉤，補齊相容對應
title.en: Import Claude Code plugins with automatic command and hook conversion for full compatibility

body.zh-TW: 搬移 Claude Code 外掛時，指令與掛鉤格式常因環境不同而無法載入。以前執行 `agy plugin import` 會把指令轉成無法載入或全名為 `SKILL` 的技能。現在每個指令都會以所在資料夾命名，`agy plugin validate` 也不再對殘留的 `commands/` 目錄警告。過去直接複製 `hooks/hooks.json`，會使掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）遭到略過。現在轉換時會將工具名稱對應為內建工具並套用 60 秒逾時，無對應項目則於摘要列出警告。⟦猶如更換轉接頭，以前規格不合會整批失效；現在自動將舊接腳轉換為標準插孔，無法對應的線路也會標註警示。⟧
body.en: When migrating Claude Code plugins, command and hook formats often fail to load due to environment differences. Previously, running `agy plugin import` converted commands into skills that failed to load or were all named `SKILL`. Now each command is named after its folder, and `agy plugin validate` no longer warns about leftover `commands/` directories. Previously, copying `hooks/hooks.json` directly caused hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) to be skipped. During conversion, tool names are now mapped to built-in tools with a 60-second timeout applied, while items with no equivalent are listed as warnings in the summary. ⟦Like fitting a replacement adapter: mismatched pins previously caused the entire setup to fail; now legacy pins automatically convert into standard sockets, and unmapped lines are flagged with clear warnings.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `agy plugin import` turning Claude Code plugin commands into skills that did not load or were all named `SKILL`; each command now becomes a skill named after its folder, including commands with no frontmatter or with Claude Code-style values such as `argument-hint: [base branch] [focus]`, and `agy plugin validate` no longer warns about the leftover `commands/` folder.
Fixed `agy plugin import` copying certain plugin's `hooks/hooks.json` unchanged, which caused the plugin's hooks to be skipped; `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `Stop`, and startup `SessionStart` hooks are now converted, with tool names in matchers mapped to built-in tools (for example `Bash` to `run_command`) and a default 60-second timeout, and hooks with no equivalent are listed as warnings in the import summary.

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式執行結束自動關閉，逾時 30 秒強制退出
title.en: Headless mode automatically shuts down after execution and forces exit on 30-second timeout

body.zh-TW: 在自動化腳本中以無頭模式（沒有視覺介面的執行模式）呼叫工具時，若背景工作卡住常會導致整個排程停滯。以前使用 `agy -p` 跑完任務印出結果後，若遇上對話標題產生等背景工作卡死，程式有時永遠不會結束退出。現在工具會在 30 秒內完成關閉程序。這個問題已經修好。
body.en: When invoking the CLI in headless mode (an execution mode without a visual interface) within automation scripts, stuck background tasks often halt the entire schedule. Previously, after completing a task and printing results with `agy -p`, the program sometimes never exited if a background task such as conversation title generation got stuck. The CLI now finishes its shutdown procedure within 30 seconds. This issue has been fixed.

items.original: Fixed `agy -p` headless runs sometimes never exiting after printing their result when a background task, such as conversation title generation, got stuck; the CLI now finishes shutting down within 30 seconds.

title.zh-TW: /teamwork 執行狀態改存應用程式資料夾，避免同目錄相互覆寫
title.en: Store /teamwork run state in app data directory to prevent mutual overwrites

body.zh-TW: 在同一個專案目錄下平行啟動多組團隊協作時，狀態檔案混用容易引發衝突。以前執行 `/teamwork` 會把狀態寫入工作目錄下的 `.agents/teamwork/` 資料夾，若在同一個工作區同時執行兩次，彼此的狀態就會互相覆寫。現在每次執行都會在工具的應用程式資料目錄下建立獨立資料夾存放狀態。這個問題已經修好。
body.en: When launching multiple team collaborations in parallel under the same project directory, mixing state files can easily trigger conflicts. Previously, running `/teamwork` wrote run state into the `.agents/teamwork/` folder in your working directory, causing two runs in the same workspace to overwrite each other. Each run now stores its state in an isolated folder under the CLI's app data directory. This issue has been fixed.

items.original: Fixed `/teamwork` writing run state into `.agents/teamwork/` in your working directory, where two runs in the same workspace could overwrite each other; each run now keeps its state in its own folder under the CLI's app data directory.

title.zh-TW: 終端機檔案連結改列完整相對路徑，無點擊支援也能辨識位置
title.en: Terminal file links display relative paths to identify locations without clickable support

body.zh-TW: 透過 SSH 連線或在傳統終端機中工作時，畫面往往無法直接點擊開啟超連結。以前代理人回覆檔案連結時只顯示檔名，在無法點擊連結的終端機（例如 Terminal.app、`screen` 或 SSH 連線）中無法辨識檔案位置。現在標籤會明確顯示相對於工作目錄的路徑、相對於 `~/` 的路徑或絕對路徑。這個問題已經修好。
body.en: When working over SSH connections or in traditional terminals, screens often cannot directly open clickable hyperlinks. Previously, file links in agent responses showed only the file name, making file locations impossible to identify in terminals that cannot open clickable links (such as Terminal.app, `screen`, or over SSH). Labels now explicitly display the path relative to your working directory, relative to `~/`, or the absolute path. This issue has been fixed.

items.original: Fixed links to files in agent responses showing only the file name, which made the file's location impossible to tell in terminals that cannot open clickable links, such as Terminal.app, `screen`, or over SSH; labels now show the path relative to your working directory, relative to `~/`, or the absolute path.

title.zh-TW: 子代理人與工作者完整保留暫存變更，支援大型目錄獨立副本
title.en: Subagents and workers fully retain uncommitted changes, supporting isolated copies for large directories

body.zh-TW: 請子代理人或蜂群工作者分頭修改程式碼時，若未提交的修改無法同步會造成進度混亂。以前子代理人與蜂群工作者取得 Git 專案副本時只會從最後一次提交開始，導致尚未提交的改動全部遺失。現在它們的工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）會完整包含已暫存、未暫存與未追蹤的所有變更。即使專案未納入版本控制，也能為工作者提供隔離的工作區資料夾，支援上限達 100,000 個項目與 4 GiB 容量。這個問題已經修好。
body.en: When asking subagents or swarm workers to modify code separately, failing to sync uncommitted changes causes confusion. Previously, when subagents and swarm workers obtained copies of a Git repository, they only started from the last commit, causing all uncommitted work to be lost. Now their worktree (a Git feature that opens multiple parallel copies of the same project) fully includes all staged, unstaged, and untracked changes. Even if a project is not under version control, the CLI can provide workers with an isolated workspace folder, supporting limits up to 100,000 entries and 4 GiB in size. This issue has been fixed.

items.original: Fixed subagents and swarm workers that get their own copy of a Git repository starting from the last commit and losing your uncommitted work; their worktree now includes your staged, unstaged, and untracked changes, and agents outside version control can give a subagent or worker an isolated copy of the workspace folder, for folders up to 100,000 entries and 4 GiB.

title.zh-TW: 未識別終端機也能用 Shift+Enter 換行
title.en: Shift+Enter can now insert newlines in unidentified terminals

body.zh-TW:
在終端機撰寫多行提示詞時，輸入過程往往習慣按住 Shift 鍵加上 Enter 換行。如果目前使用的終端機未被工具自動識別，以前按這組按鍵常常無法順利插入換行。

⟦跟飯店櫃檯調整接待方式一樣，以前門僮沒看見熟悉的護照封面就只會講單句英文，現在改好接待安排，遇到陌生封面也能流暢長談。⟧

現在只要在設定檔的 `[ui]` 區塊加入以下設定：

```toml
[ui]
kitty_keyboard = "query"
```

將選項設為 `query` 之後，即便終端機屬於未識別型號，按 Shift+Enter 也能正常插入換行字元。
body.en:
When writing multi-line prompts in a terminal, people often press and hold Shift along with Enter to insert newlines. If the current terminal is not automatically recognized by the tool, pressing this key combination previously often failed to insert newlines smoothly.

⟦A hotel front desk adjusts its reception workflow: previously, if the doorman did not see a familiar passport cover, they would speak only in single English sentences, but after updating the arrangements, they can converse smoothly at length even with unfamiliar covers.⟧

Now, you only need to add the following setting under the `[ui]` section of your configuration file:

```toml
[ui]
kitty_keyboard = "query"
```

After setting the option to `query`, pressing Shift+Enter inserts newline characters normally, even if the terminal is an unidentified model.

items.original: `[ui] kitty_keyboard = "query"` lets Shift+Enter insert newlines in unidentified terminals

title.zh-TW: MCP 伺服器連線不再於工作階段重新載入或更新時無故重啟
title.en: MCP server connections no longer restart unnecessarily on session reloads or updates

body.zh-TW:
藉由 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）擴充能力時，你可能會在同一個工作階段中連續處理多項工作。以前在工作階段重新載入或更新時，伺服器連線會跟著無故重啟。

⟦彷彿與外聘顧問保持電話會議，以前每當你更換手邊的討論議程，通話都會無故斷線重撥；現在換議程時，不會再無故斷線重撥。⟧

連線機制調整後，工作階段在重新載入或更新時，不會再莫名重啟既有的伺服器連線。
body.en:
When expanding capabilities through MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that connects AI to external tools), you might handle multiple tasks consecutively within the same session. Previously, server connections would restart unnecessarily whenever a session was reloaded or updated.

⟦Much like keeping an ongoing conference call with an external consultant, previously whenever you switched the discussion agenda at hand, the call would hang up and redial without cause; now when switching agendas, it will no longer disconnect and redial unnecessarily.⟧

Following adjustments to the connection mechanism, existing server connections no longer restart unnecessarily when a session is reloaded or updated.

items.original: MCP server connections no longer restart unnecessarily on session reloads or updates

title.zh-TW: 修正介面多處互動細節，複製與畫面狀態更一致
title.en: Multiple interface interaction details fixed, making copying and screen states more consistent

body.zh-TW:
日常在終端機操作與翻閱紀錄時，游標點擊與畫面資訊的同步表現直接影響使用手感。

引述複製功能現在會完整保留連結中的 `&` 符號；在未選中文字的空白處連按兩下，也不會再誤將思考區塊折疊起來。

快捷鍵 `Ctrl+L` 現在可在更多畫面上使用，且畫面上的複製提示文字，也與實際複製到剪貼簿的內容保持相符。

在執行倒轉操作後，頁尾顯示的上下文用量不再會降為零或顯示過期數值。

在 `/resume` 清單中查看歷史項目時，每一列內容的展開與折疊方式，現在與工作階段內部完全一致。

以前在倒轉後容易看見用量數值失準，或複製連結時遺失特定符號，現在這些介面問題都已經修好。
body.en:
During everyday terminal operations and when browsing history, cursor clicks and the synchronization of screen information directly affect the overall feel.

Quote copy now fully preserves the `&` symbol in links, and double-clicking on empty space with no text selected no longer mistakenly folds thoughts.

The `Ctrl+L` shortcut now works on more screens, and copy hints on screen match what actually copies to the clipboard.

After performing a rewind, context usage shown in the footer no longer drops to zero or displays stale values.

When viewing history items in the `/resume` list, the way each row expands and collapses is now completely consistent with how it behaves inside a session.

Previously, usage values could easily become inaccurate after a rewind, or specific symbols could be lost when copying links; these interface issues have now all been fixed.

entries: On macOS and Linux, permission profiles extending `:ask-me` with filesystem `deny` rules now enforce them: workspace-root deny globs (`**/*.pem`) and absolute/`~/` denies refuse matching reads and writes, and sandboxed shell access to matching paths that exist when each shell command starts (files created mid-command under a deny glob are not covered on Linux — macOS enforces globs live through Seatbelt regex with no snapshot window; a deny on a not-yet-existing path is masked at its first missing component), instead of being silently ignored, while the profile keeps its write grants elsewhere
`muse usage` shows your subscription allowance (window and weekly use, reset times, tier) without running a model turn; `muse exec --json` reads it too when the run saw no usage update
Desktop and other connected clients offer the same third-party models as the terminal model picker

Added a built-in `visual-coding` skill: for a 3D page, a browser game or Blender work, it points the agent to the one built-in skill that owns that kind of work before any code is written, so one request no longer runs two competing build processes
Warnings near your usage limit show the remaining allowance and reset time above the message queue
`/game-3d-visuals` now runs its plan, build and review as three steps and posts a one-line result to the todo list after each

When cleanup after a finished turn keeps failing (goal accounting or the live turn state), the chat now shows one "cleanup failed after this turn" warning naming what gave up, instead of failing silently. It shows right after that turn, or the next time you open the chat if you have already moved on to another turn (in the rare case that the warning itself could not be saved, it shows only while you are still on that turn)
`--yolo` keeps the `request_user_input` question tool and enables async questions instead of withholding them; pass `--disable-request-user-input` for runs that should ask nothing
Security: Sessions in untrusted workspaces no longer receive project rules recorded by an earlier trusted session
Security: Session worktree recovery now enforces the same protected paths as the rest of the session

Security: Served sessions in workspaces you have not trusted no longer run workspace status checks or Sapling snapshots, and sessions that never establish trust now fail closed instead of inheriting trusted behavior

Security: When `muse serve` resumes, forks or opens a side chat from a chat whose saved history lost a permission change, the chat no longer reopens with older, wider permissions: it resets to your defaults, keeps your saved settings when they were stricter, or switches to read-only when the two cannot be safely combined, and "allow for this session" approvals given before the loss stop applying. A permission profile you choose when resuming such a chat applies after the reset, or in its place when the reset is not allowed. title.zh-TW: macOS 與 Linux 支援檔案系統拒絕規則，嚴格阻擋敏感路徑讀寫
title.en: Filesystem Deny Rules Supported on macOS and Linux to Strictly Block Sensitive Path Access

body.zh-TW: 當你在權限設定檔中擴充 `:ask-me` 並加入檔案系統 `deny` 規則時，系統現在會在 macOS 與 Linux 上確實強制執行。無論是工作區根目錄的萬用字元（如 `**/*.pem`），還是絕對路徑與家目錄 `~/` 的拒絕規則，都會直接拒絕符合條件的讀寫請求，並限制沙盒 Shell 存取指令啟動時已存在的符合路徑。⟦跟金庫的門禁感應卡一樣，原本只交代警衛口頭留意，現在閘門讀卡機直接鎖定黑名單區域，非許可人員碰觸感應區就立刻鳴笛拒絕。⟧在 Linux 上，指令執行中途於萬用字元下新建的檔案不受保護；macOS 則透過 Seatbelt 正規表達式（用符號匹配字串的語法）即時防堵且無快照空窗。至於尚未存在的路徑，會在第一個缺失層級先行遮蔽，而設定檔在其他位置的寫入授權則維持不變。
body.en: When you extend `:ask-me` in a permission profile with filesystem `deny` rules, the system now enforces them on macOS and Linux. Whether using workspace-root deny globs (such as `**/*.pem`) or absolute and home directory `~/` deny rules, matching read and write requests are directly refused, and sandboxed shell access to matching paths that exist when each shell command starts is blocked. ⟦Just as a vault card reader secures restricted areas, where guards were previously only told to keep watch verbally, the card reader now actively locks down blacklisted zones and sounds an alarm whenever unauthorized personnel touch the sensor.⟧ On Linux, files created mid-command under a deny glob are not covered. macOS prevents them live through Seatbelt regex (syntax for matching text patterns with symbols) with no snapshot window. Denies on not-yet-existing paths are masked at their first missing component, while the profile keeps its write grants elsewhere.

items.original: On macOS and Linux, permission profiles extending `:ask-me` with filesystem `deny` rules now enforce them: workspace-root deny globs (`**/*.pem`) and absolute/`~/` denies refuse matching reads and writes, and sandboxed shell access to matching paths that exist when each shell command starts (files created mid-command under a deny glob are not covered on Linux — macOS enforces globs live through Seatbelt regex with no snapshot window; a deny on a not-yet-existing path is masked at its first missing component), instead of being silently ignored, while the profile keeps its write grants elsewhere

title.zh-TW: 支援獨立查詢訂閱額度，用量接近上限時主動警示
title.en: Standalone Subscription Allowance Queries Supported with Proactive Warnings Near Limits

body.zh-TW: 如果你想確認自己剩餘的模型使用次數，現在不必發送訊息觸發模型就能直接掌握。執行 `muse usage` 會顯示訂閱額度（包含時間區間、每週用量、重設時間與方案等級）；當指令沒有產生新的用量更新時，`muse exec --json` 也會同步讀取該資訊。⟦恰似手機隨時打開電信公司帳務頁面，以前非得打通電話才能在帳單看到剩餘網路流量，現在打開面板就能直接查餘額。⟧當你快達到用量上限時，訊息佇列上方會跳出警告，標示剩餘可用額度與重設時間。一旦觸發用量限制而中斷，畫面會明確說明何時能繼續發問，被拒絕的請求也會保留完整的錯誤細節供你排查。
body.en: If you want to check your remaining model usage, you can now check it directly without sending a message to run a model turn. Running `muse usage` displays your subscription allowance (including window, weekly use, reset times, and tier). When a run sees no new usage updates, `muse exec --json` reads that information as well. ⟦Think of opening your mobile carrier billing page on your phone at any time: instead of having to place a call to see remaining data on your bill, you can now open the panel and check your balance directly.⟧ When you are near your usage limit, a warning appears above the message queue showing your remaining allowance and reset time. If execution stops due to a usage limit, the interface clearly explains when you can continue asking questions, and denied requests retain full error details for troubleshooting.

items.original:
`muse usage` shows your subscription allowance (window and weekly use, reset times, tier) without running a model turn; `muse exec --json` reads it too when the run saw no usage update
Warnings near your usage limit show the remaining allowance and reset time above the message queue
Usage limit stops explain when you can continue, and denied requests retain useful error details

title.zh-TW: 內建視覺程式設計技能引導分流，3D 遊戲管線分步回報待辦清單
title.en: Built-In Visual Coding Skill Guides Triage as 3D Game Pipeline Posts Steps to Todo List

body.zh-TW: 當你要求代理人製作 3D 網頁、瀏覽器遊戲或處理 Blender 專案時，現在內建的 `visual-coding` 技能會在動筆寫程式前，主動引導代理人使用負責該領域的單一內建技能，避免單次請求同時啟動兩套相互衝突的建置流程。⟦宛如醫院的分診服務台，病患剛進門就先依症狀指引至專屬診間，不再讓兩個科別同時搶著收治同一位病人。⟧針對 `/game-3d-visuals` 指令，現在會依序拆分為規劃、建置與審查三個步驟執行，並在每步完成後向待辦清單回報單行結果。該技能現在也會明確為每次管線執行命名，首次啟動不再遭到拒絕或被迫重新嘗試。
body.en: When you ask an agent to build a 3D page, a browser game, or handle a Blender project, the built-in `visual-coding` skill now actively directs the agent to the single built-in skill responsible for that domain before writing any code, preventing one request from launching two competing build processes. ⟦Picture a hospital triage desk directing incoming patients to designated specialty rooms based on symptoms, stopping two departments from competing to treat the same patient.⟧ For the `/game-3d-visuals` command, execution is now split into three sequential steps: planning, building, and reviewing, posting a one-line result to the todo list after each step finishes. The skill also explicitly names each pipeline run, so its first launch is no longer refused or forced to retry.

items.original:
Added a built-in `visual-coding` skill: for a 3D page, a browser game or Blender work, it points the agent to the one built-in skill that owns that kind of work before any code is written, so one request no longer runs two competing build processes
`/game-3d-visuals` now runs its plan, build and review as three steps and posts a one-line result to the todo list after each
The `game-3d-visuals` skill now names each of its pipeline runs, so its first launch is no longer refused and retried

title.zh-TW: YOLO 模式保留提問工具，支援非同步向使用者確認需求
title.en: YOLO Mode Retains Question Tool and Supports Async Inquiries to Confirm Requirements

body.zh-TW: 平時使用 `--yolo` 參數讓工具自動執行任務時，往往既希望節省確認步驟，又擔心重要決策缺乏溝通。現在 `--yolo` 不再全面扣留提問，而是保留了 `request_user_input` 提問工具，並啟用非同步提問機制，讓代理人在背景運作時仍能提出關鍵問題。⟦好比全自動導航的貨運卡車，平常維持自主駕駛，遇到收件地址不清楚時能在儀表板發出非同步通知等你確認，不必被迫停在路中央發呆。⟧如果你希望執行過程完全不被打擾、不詢問任何問題，只要額外加上 `--disable-request-user-input` 參數，就能徹底關閉提問。
body.en: When using the `--yolo` flag to let tools execute tasks automatically, you often want to save confirmation steps without missing important decisions. The `--yolo` flag no longer withholds questions completely; instead, it keeps the `request_user_input` question tool and enables an async questioning mechanism, allowing the agent to ask essential questions while running in the background. ⟦Like an autonomous delivery truck driving smoothly on its own, it can post an async notification on the dashboard for your confirmation whenever a delivery address is unclear, rather than stalling out in the middle of the road.⟧ If you prefer the execution process to run entirely uninterrupted without asking anything, pass `--disable-request-user-input` to disable questions completely.

items.original: `--yolo` keeps the `request_user_input` question tool and enables async questions instead of withholding them; pass `--disable-request-user-input` for runs that should ask nothing

title.zh-TW: 嚴格隔離未受信任工作區，伺服端權限異常時主動降級重設
title.en: Strict Isolation for Untrusted Workspaces with Proactive Reset on Server Permission Anomalies

body.zh-TW: 打開未知來源的專案資料夾時，安全性設定會更嚴密地劃清界線。未受信任工作區的工作階段不再接收先前受信任工作階段記錄的專案規則；工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）復原也遵守相同的保護路徑。未受信任工作區的託管工作階段不再執行工作區狀態檢查或 Sapling 快照，未建立信任就拒絕繼續。⟦猶如訪客不再繼承前人的通行鑰匙，門禁紀錄有缺漏時，也不能沿用舊鑰匙放行。⟧`muse serve` 恢復、分支或開啟側邊對話時，若歷史遺失權限變更，不再沿用較寬鬆的舊權限：會重設為預設值，保留較嚴格的已存設定，只有兩組設定無法安全合併才轉唯讀。遺失前「允許此工作階段」的授權失效。恢復時選擇的權限設定檔在重設後套用；若不允許重設，就取代重設。無安全重設途徑或管理原則禁止時，會拒絕開啟並要求另開新對話。
body.en: When opening project folders from unknown sources, security settings draw a stricter boundary. Sessions in untrusted workspaces no longer receive project rules recorded by earlier trusted sessions. Session worktree (Git's feature for running multiple parallel copies of the same project) recovery now enforces the same protected paths. Hosted sessions in untrusted workspaces no longer run workspace status checks or Sapling snapshots, refusing to continue if trust is never established. ⟦A visitor no longer inherits access keys left behind by a predecessor, and missing log entries also prevent old keys from granting admission.⟧ When `muse serve` resumes, forks, or opens a side chat from history that lost a permission change, it no longer reopens with older, wider permissions: it resets to defaults, keeps your saved settings when they were stricter, or switches to read-only when the two cannot be safely combined. Prior approvals for "allow for this session" given before the loss stop applying. A permission profile chosen when resuming applies after the reset, or replaces the reset when resetting is not allowed. When no safe reset exists or managed policy forbids it, the chat refuses to open and asks you to start a new chat.

items.original:
Security: Sessions in untrusted workspaces no longer receive project rules recorded by an earlier trusted session
Security: Session worktree recovery now enforces the same protected paths as the rest of the session
Security: Served sessions in workspaces you have not trusted no longer run workspace status checks or Sapling snapshots, and sessions that never establish trust now fail closed instead of inheriting trusted behavior
Security: When `muse serve` resumes, forks or opens a side chat from a chat whose saved history lost a permission change, the chat no longer reopens with older, wider permissions: it resets to your defaults, keeps your saved settings when they were stricter, or switches to read-only when the two cannot be safely combined, and "allow for this session" approvals given before the loss stop applying. A permission profile you choose when resuming such a chat applies after the reset, or in its place when the reset is not allowed. When no safe reset exists, or managed policy forbids it, the chat refuses and asks you to start a new chat

title.zh-TW: 分支對話遇磁碟寫入失敗不中斷，重啟自動略過異常回合
title.en: Forked Chats Continue Through Disk Write Failures and Skip Abnormal Turns on Reopen

body.zh-TW: 在磁碟空間不足的環境下建立分支對話，若是某次回合開頭未能成功寫入硬碟，現在不會再卡死整體流程。這類分支對話在完成壓縮並重新開啟後仍可正常運作，重啟時也會再度儲存檢查點；應用程式或其他客戶端載入時，不再阻擋後續檢查點儲存，即使是從已壓縮對話建立的分支也能順利接續。⟦就跟搭乘區間火車碰上某節車廂門鎖損壞一樣，站務員會將該車廂清空並在發車時廣播通知一次，其餘車廂與列車排班依舊準時行駛。⟧系統會將未能成功寫入的回合排除在紀錄之外，並在每次重新載入時清楚提醒你一次，確保對話能持續進行而不中斷。
body.en: Creating a forked chat in low-disk-space environments no longer blocks the entire flow if the start of one of its turns cannot be written to disk. Such forked chats continue working normally after compacting and reopening, saving checkpoints again upon restart. Loading them in an application or another client no longer blocks subsequent checkpoints, allowing forks from compacted chats to continue smoothly. ⟦When a commuter train encounters a damaged carriage door lock, station staff clear that carriage and make a single announcement before departure, while the rest of the train keeps running on schedule.⟧ The system leaves unwritten turns out of the record and reminds you once per reopen, ensuring the chat can proceed without interruption.

A forked chat where the start of one of its own turns could not be written to disk keeps working after it compacts and is reopened; that turn stays left out, and Muse says so once per reopen
A forked chat where the start of one of its own turns could not be written to disk (for example on a full disk) saves checkpoints again after a restart; that turn is left out, and Muse says so once

title.zh-TW: 磁碟滿載或存取中斷自動復原，錯誤排除即刻接續儲存進度
title.en: Automatic Recovery from Full Disks or Interrupted Storage Resumes Progress Immediately

body.zh-TW: 面對暫時性的硬碟存取異常，工作階段現在具備更靈活的自我復原能力。工具執行結果若因磁碟已滿等原因儲存失敗，對話依然能立即執行壓縮，重啟後該回合會完整保留並標註結果已遺失，不再無故消失。當讀取對話檔案因短暫輸入輸出錯誤受阻，一旦讀取恢復正常，對話便會重新儲存進度，不必被迫重啟。即便子代理訊息或背景紀錄因磁碟空間不足存檔失敗，壓縮檢查點無須重啟即可恢復運作。任務中途或背景儲存遭遇短暫磁碟故障時，只要錯誤排除，在下個檢查點便會接續存檔，範圍亦涵蓋側邊對話與已寫入磁碟的紀錄。在寫入持續失敗期間，系統也會減少重複的工作階段日誌登記，避免資源耗損。
body.en: Sessions now feature more resilient self-recovery when encountering temporary storage access errors. If saving a tool result fails due to a full disk or similar issue, the chat can still compact immediately; after a restart, that turn is preserved with the result marked as lost instead of disappearing. When reading a chat file is blocked by a brief I/O error, the chat resumes saving progress once the read succeeds, without requiring a restart. Compaction checkpoints continue working without a chat restart even if saving a subagent message or background record fails due to lack of disk space. When a brief disk error occurs mid-task or interrupts a background save, progress saving resumes at the next checkpoint once the error clears, covering side chats and records already written to disk. While disk writes keep failing, the system also reduces repeated session-log bookkeeping to avoid consuming resources.

items.original:
A chat whose tool result could not be saved (for example on a full disk) can compact again right away, and after a restart that turn is kept with the result shown as lost, instead of disappearing
When a chat's file could not be read while loading it for a save (a brief I/O error), the chat goes back to saving its progress once the read works again, instead of staying unable to save until restart
After a subagent message or other background record could not be saved to a full disk, compaction checkpoints work again without restarting the chat
After a brief storage error in the middle of a task, the chat goes back to saving its progress at the next checkpoint once the error clears, instead of waiting for the task's next tool call or its end
After a brief disk error interrupts one background save, the chat goes back to saving its progress once the error clears, also when the save had fully reached the disk or belonged to a side chat
Reduce repeated session-log bookkeeping while disk writes are failing

title.zh-TW: 長期目標與對話壓縮穩定保存，回合清理失敗會顯示警告
title.en: Long-Running Goals and Chat Compactions Save Reliably with Warnings on Cleanup Failures

body.zh-TW: 長時間執行複雜任務時，對話歷史與檢查點的保存機制能維持正常節奏。漫長的 `/goal` 任務會正常儲存恢復檢查點，使內容維持精簡並迅速恢復，不再每次壓縮後逐漸變慢。對話呼叫子代理再同時執行多項工具後，後續檢查點不再停止儲存；提示詞格式神似訊息封套，也不會阻礙後續工作階段儲存恢復檢查點。模型回應提早結束時，自動壓縮不再遺失監視器訊息；背景任務尚未確認儲存時觸發壓縮，也會儲存檢查點，並保留舊歷史直到背景儲存結果確定，不再跳過儲存。如果回合結束後的清理持續失敗（例如目標計帳或即時狀態），對話會在該回合後顯示一次警告，指名失敗項目；若已進入另一回合，則下次開啟對話時顯示。若警告本身未能存檔，就只在你仍停留於該回合時顯示。
body.en: When executing complex tasks over long durations, the saving mechanism for chat history and checkpoints maintains a steady cadence. Long `/goal` sessions reliably save resume checkpoints again, keeping content compact and restoring quickly instead of slowing down after every compaction. After a chat messages a subagent and runs multiple tools at once, subsequent checkpoints no longer stop saving. Prompts formatted like session-message envelopes also no longer prevent future sessions from saving resume checkpoints. Automatic compaction no longer loses Monitor messages when a model response ends early. Triggering compaction while a background task save remains unconfirmed still saves checkpoints, keeping older history until the background save resolves instead of skipping the save. If cleanup after a finished turn keeps failing (such as goal accounting or live turn state), the chat displays one warning naming the failed item right after that turn, or the next time you open the chat if you have moved on to another turn. If the warning itself cannot be saved, it appears only while you remain on that turn.

It shows right after that turn, or the next time you open the chat if you have already moved on to another turn (in the rare case that the warning itself could not be saved, it shows only while you are still on that turn)

title.zh-TW: 背景工作流程保留待辦清單，終止與暫停狀態回報更明確
title.en: Background Workflows Retain Todo Lists with Clearer Stopping and Pausing Reports

body.zh-TW: 讓代理人在背景執行長時間任務時，你能更清楚掌握各項流程的即時動態。啟動背景工作流程後，待辦清單在該流程運作期間會持續保留在螢幕上，不再隨著觸發它的對話回合結束而立刻消失。當你手動中斷操作時，停止訊息會明確標註停下的是工作流程還是背景指令。⟦就像工廠中央監控台的流水線看板，即便操作員切換畫面，組裝進度依然常駐顯示，按下急停鈕時也會清楚標明停機的是輸送帶還是檢驗站。⟧若工作流程剛好執行完畢才按下暫停，畫面會直接回報已完成並顯示執行結果，避免卡在無結果的暫停狀態。使用帶有 `stop: true` 的 `session/leave` 時，若工作流程因停止紀錄衝突而無法停止，離開操作會失敗，工作階段仍留在原主機。已知限制是：即使用新的指令識別碼重試，也會持續失敗，直到主機程序重啟。
body.en: When letting an agent run long-running tasks in the background, you get clearer visibility into the real-time status of each process. After launching a background workflow, the todo list remains on screen while the workflow runs, rather than disappearing as soon as the turn that triggered it ends. When you manually stop an operation, the stopping message clearly indicates whether a workflow or a background command was stopped. ⟦Much like a central assembly dashboard in a factory, progress remains visible on screen even when operators switch views, and pressing an emergency stop clarifies whether the conveyor belt or the inspection station was paused.⟧ If you pause a workflow right after it finishes, the interface directly reports that it has completed and displays the execution result, avoiding getting stuck in a paused state with no result. When using `session/leave` with `stop: true`, if a workflow cannot be stopped due to a conflicting stop record, the leave fails and the session remains with its host. As a known limitation, such leaves continue to fail even when retried with a new command id, until the host process restarts.

items.original:
Stopping messages say whether a workflow or a background command was stopped
`session/leave` with `stop: true` no longer releases a session while one of its workflows cannot be stopped (its stop record is in conflict); the leave fails and the session stays with its host, including when you retry it with a new command id; until the host process restarts, such a leave keeps failing (a known limitation)
The todo list now stays on screen while a background workflow is still running, instead of disappearing as soon as the turn that launched it ends
Pausing a Workflow that has just finished now reports that it already finished and shows its result, instead of leaving the Workflow paused with no result

title.zh-TW: 子代理通訊保留文字摘要，取消佇列與對等時間軸正常運作
title.en: Subagent Communication Preserves Plain Summaries as Unqueue and Peer Timelines Function Normally

body.zh-TW: 在多代理人協同運作的環境中，訊息傳遞與佇列排程的管理更加井然有序。透過遠端工作階段向子代理發送便籤時，文字摘要會完整保留，不再遺失原貌；當子代理正忙於處理其他事務，等待中的便籤會明確標記為排隊中，方便追蹤派工狀況。⟦如同辦公室的專案交接留言板，交代給助理的便條紙會整齊貼在排隊欄位並保留原始重點，想抽回尚未處理的留言也能隨時撤下。⟧使用 `turn/unqueue` 撤回排隊訊息時，即便訊息排在內部回合後方，也能順利取消，不再誤報找不到執行個體而強制執行。工作階段自動接收訊息後，對等節點的訊息時間軸亦會正常顯示，不再出現無法使用的錯誤提示。
body.en: In multi-agent collaborative environments, message routing and queue scheduling are organized more cleanly. Notes sent to a subagent over a remote session preserve their plain summary rather than losing their original appearance. When a subagent is busy handling other tasks, waiting notes clearly show Queued rows to facilitate tracking dispatch status. ⟦In an office handover board, notes assigned to an assistant stay neatly in the queue column with their original takeaways intact, and pending messages can be pulled back at any time.⟧ When revoking a queued message using `turn/unqueue`, the cancellation succeeds even if the message waits behind an internal turn, instead of incorrectly failing with `missing_run` and running the message anyway. After a session accepts a message automatically, the peer message timeline also displays normally, without showing an unavailable error.

items.original:
Notes sent to a subagent over a remote session keep their plain summary
Removing a queued message with `turn/unqueue` now works when the message is waiting behind an internal turn, instead of failing with `missing_run` and running the message anyway
Notes waiting on a busy subagent now show Queued rows while they wait
The peer message timeline no longer shows as unavailable after a session accepts a message automatically

title.zh-TW: 桌面端同步第三方模型選單，工作階段命名回歸且降低記憶體
title.en: Desktop Syncs Third-Party Models, Restoring Session Names and Reducing Memory

body.zh-TW: 切換使用不同介面時，模型選單與工作階段清單現在具備一致的體驗。桌面端與其他連線客戶端現在提供與終端機模型選單完全相同的第三方模型選項。你先前為工作階段自訂的名稱會重新列在清單中，並能依據自己的歷史紀錄直接使用 `muse resume <name>` 恢復對話。⟦仿照商品目錄的輕量索引設計，展架上只陳列品名與貨號，不必把整批庫存貨物堆在走道上。⟧其他工作階段仍在執行時，啟動應用程式或 `muse serve` 會減少記憶體用量，因為列出工作階段清單不再保留每個執行中工作階段的完整歷史副本。使用 `/feedback` 回報問題時，若紀錄過於龐大，系統會自動縮減至合適大小並附上標註，不再因檔案過大而失敗。
body.en: When switching between different interfaces, the model menu and session list now provide a consistent experience. Desktop and other connected clients now offer the exact same third-party model options as the terminal model picker. Session names you customized earlier show up again in the list and can directly resume conversations with `muse resume <name>`, read from each session's own history. ⟦Following a lightweight catalog index design, display shelves only present item names and item numbers without stacking the entire inventory stock in the aisles.⟧ Starting the app or `muse serve` while other sessions are running uses less memory, because listing sessions no longer keeps a full copy of each running session's history. When reporting issues with `/feedback`, if a record is very large, the system automatically shortens it to fit and adds a note, so it no longer fails due to oversized files.

items.original:
Desktop and other connected clients offer the same third-party models as the terminal model picker
Session names you gave earlier show up again in the session list and work with `muse resume <name>`, read from each session's own history
`/feedback` uploads with a very large session record no longer fail; the record is shortened to fit and the shortening is noted
Starting the app or `muse serve` while other sessions are running uses much less memory, because listing sessions no longer keeps a full copy of each running session's history

title.zh-TW: 掛鉤注入資訊限制於當前對話，避免模型重新處理完整歷史
title.en: Hook Context Stays in Current Conversation, Preventing Full History Reprocessing

body.zh-TW: 如果你平時利用自動化腳本擴充提示詞或工具結果，現在資料注入的範圍劃分得更為明確。在提示詞或工具呼叫後，透過掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）加入的上下文資訊，現在會被嚴格限制在該資訊抵達的對話之中。⟦看齊公文批閱的浮貼便籤機制，新加上的審核意見只貼在當前公文夾，不必把整份歷史檔案抽出來從頭到尾重審一遍。⟧新增掛鉤規則後，下次呼叫模型不再重新處理整段對話。
body.en: If you typically use automation scripts to augment prompts or tool results, the scope of data injection is now more clearly defined. After a prompt or tool call, context added through hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) is now strictly confined to the conversation where that information arrived. ⟦Adopting the sticky-note mechanism used in document review, newly added review comments are attached solely to the current folder instead of pulling out the entire historical archive to re-examine from start to finish.⟧ After adding a new hook rule, the next model call no longer re-processes the entire conversation.

items.original: Context that hooks add after a prompt or tool call now stays in the conversation where it arrived, so a new hook rule no longer makes the whole conversation re-process on the next model call

entries: **The Antigravity status line shows when each quota resets.** Next to the 5-hour and weekly percentages it now prints the reset clock time and the time left, for example `18:37(2h30m left)`, in the same format as the Claude Code status line.

**The Antigravity status line now uses two lines, like the Claude Code one.** Project and quota windows stay on the first line, and the model and context window move to the second, so the reset times still fit in an 80-column terminal instead of being dropped first.

**Terse mode keeps replies readable while it shortens them.** Its instructions now set a floor: the reader gets each reply in one pass. They ask for common word pairings and the verb near its subject, and keep connecting words such as "because" and "so". This follows a recent study that found pressure to be brief is one cause of hard-to-read AI text.

**Codex subagent threads are counted again.** A thread started by `spawn_agent` repeats the parent's session header but no longer its token events, so usage could not match it to the parent and skipped the whole file. These threads are now counted from zero; on the machine where it was found, about 0.4% of Codex tokens had been missing.
**Fable 5.2 has an offline price and a short name.** Costs for it no longer show as missing when the price table cannot be downloaded, and it appears as `Fable 5.2` in tables and charts.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 狀態列改為雙排顯示，補上額度重置時刻與剩餘時間
title.en: Antigravity status line switches to two lines, adding quota reset times and time remaining

body.zh-TW: 緊盯著邊長受限的終端機視窗趕工時，最怕算不清手邊的呼叫配額何時重置。⟦走進候車亭看動態看板，以前單排螢幕擠不下完整字樣，抵達時間常最先被裁切；現在改成分層播送，上方列出路線、下方顯示倒數分鐘，小螢幕也能一眼看齊。⟧Antigravity 的 status line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）現在採用雙排設計，排版樣式比照 Claude Code。第一排固定保留專案與額度視窗，第二排則放模型與上下文視窗（模型一次可處理的內容容量）。在 5 小時和每週額度的百分比旁，會直接印出重置時刻與剩餘時間，例如 `18:37(2h30m left)`，意思是 18:37 重置、還剩 2 小時 30 分鐘。即使終端機只有 80 格寬，重置時間依然放得下，不再被優先省略。
body.en: When rushing through work while watching a space-constrained terminal window, the worst feeling is losing track of when active call quotas reset. ⟦Think of checking a dynamic display at a bus shelter: where a single-row screen once could not fit all text and cut off arrival times first, a tiered broadcast now lists routes on top and countdown minutes below, letting small screens show everything at a glance.⟧ Antigravity's status line (the status display at the bottom of the terminal) now uses a two-line layout modeled after Claude Code. The first line keeps project and quota windows, while the second line holds the model and context window (the amount of content a model can process at once). Next to the 5-hour and weekly percentages, it prints the reset clock time and time left, such as `18:37(2h30m left)`, meaning it resets at 18:37 with 2 hours and 30 minutes left. Even if the terminal is only 80 columns wide, reset times still fit and are no longer dropped first.

items.original:
**The Antigravity status line shows when each quota resets.** Next to the 5-hour and weekly percentages it now prints the reset clock time and the time left, for example `18:37(2h30m left)`, in the same format as the Claude Code status line.
**The Antigravity status line now uses two lines, like the Claude Code one.** Project and quota windows stay on the first line, and the model and context window move to the second, so the reset times still fit in an 80-column terminal instead of being dropped first.

title.zh-TW: 精簡模式兼顧文字可讀性，縮短回覆依然讀一遍就懂
title.en: Terse mode preserves readability, keeping shortened replies clear in one pass

body.zh-TW: 請 AI 簡明扼要回答問題時，最常遇到文字被過度壓縮而難以理解的窘境。⟦報社主編濃縮長篇通訊，以前為了塞進有限版面猛砍連接詞，讀者讀起來反而滿頭問號；現在改寫時要求句型完整且詞語自然，篇幅變短卻依然一讀就通。⟧精簡模式（terse mode，縮減回覆長度的輸出模式）現在替回覆品質設下底線，要求讀者讀一遍就能看懂。這套指示要求語句採用常見的慣用搭配詞，動詞必須盡量靠近主詞，並強制保留「因為」與「所以」等關鍵連接詞。這項改進依據一項最新研究：逼迫 AI 寫短，正是其文字變得晦澀難懂的原因之一。
body.en: When asking an AI for concise answers, users often encounter text compressed so heavily that it becomes hard to understand. ⟦Picture a newspaper editor condensing long dispatches: where conjunctions were once aggressively cut to fit limited space and left readers puzzled, rewrites now require complete sentence structures and natural phrasing so shortened copy remains clear in one pass.⟧ Terse mode (an output mode that shortens reply length) now sets a quality floor, requiring that readers understand each reply in one pass. These instructions require common word pairings, keep the verb as close as possible to its subject, and mandate preserving key connecting words such as "because" and "so". This improvement follows a recent study: pressuring AI to be brief is itself one reason its text becomes obscure and hard to understand.

items.original: **Terse mode keeps replies readable while it shortens them.** Its instructions now set a floor: the reader gets each reply in one pass. They ask for common word pairings and the verb near its subject, and keep connecting words such as "because" and "so". This follows a recent study that found pressure to be brief is one cause of hard-to-read AI text.

title.zh-TW: Codex 子代理用量重新計入，獨立統計不再整份略過
title.en: Codex subagent usage is counted again, tracked independently instead of skipping whole files

body.zh-TW: 指揮背景代理分頭處理繁重任務之後，翻開用量報告卻可能發現統計數據對不上。⟦工讀生協助分裝包裹，以前簽收單雖寫著總部抬頭卻漏貼明細，會計對不上總帳便整批退件；現在獨立開立單據從零計算，派工產生的開銷全部如實入帳。⟧由 `spawn_agent` 啟動的子代理執行緒會複製父層工作階段的開頭標頭，卻不再複製父層的 token（計量 AI 處理與計費的文字單位）事件。過去 usage 因為無法將它對齊父對話，會將整份紀錄檔直接略過。現在這類子代理紀錄已改為從零開始統計。在發現此問題的電腦上，先前大約少算了 0.4% 的 Codex token 用量。
body.en: After directing background agents to handle heavy tasks in parallel, opening a usage report might reveal figures that fail to match. ⟦An intern helps pack parcels: while receipt slips once showed headquarters headers but omitted itemized details, prompting accounting to reject whole batches when totals failed to match, independent invoices are now issued from scratch so all dispatch expenses are recorded faithfully.⟧ A subagent thread launched by `spawn_agent` copies the header of the parent session, but no longer copies the parent's token (the text unit used to measure AI processing and billing) events. Previously, because usage could not match it to the parent conversation, it skipped the entire log file. These subagent records are now counted from zero instead. On the machine where this issue was found, about 0.4% of Codex token usage had previously gone uncounted.

items.original: **Codex subagent threads are counted again.** A thread started by `spawn_agent` repeats the parent's session header but no longer its token events, so usage could not match it to the parent and skipped the whole file. These threads are now counted from zero; on the machine where it was found, about 0.4% of Codex tokens had been missing.

title.zh-TW: Fable 5.2 補上離線價格備援，圖表統一顯示簡稱
title.en: Fable 5.2 adds an offline price fallback, displaying a short name across charts

body.zh-TW: 遇到網路斷線或離線工作的場合，查看模型支出報表常會因為缺乏即時價目而留下空白。⟦便利商店刷條碼結帳，以前連不上總部系統就直接顯示無此商品，發票品名也印得落落長；現在機台內建離線公定價，收據上更統一印出簡潔的商品代號。⟧針對 Fable 5.2 模型，系統現在內建了離線價格設定。價目表無法下載時，Fable 5.2 的費用也不再顯示為缺漏。各類用量表格與統計圖表也統一將其名稱標示為簡潔的 `Fable 5.2`。
body.en: When working offline or experiencing a network disconnection, reviewing model spending reports often left blanks because real-time pricing was unavailable. ⟦At a convenience store barcode checkout, losing connection to headquarters once prompted registers to display items as missing while printing overly long names on receipts; machines now embed offline list prices and consistently print concise product codes instead.⟧ For the Fable 5.2 model, the system now includes built-in offline pricing. When the price table cannot be downloaded, costs for Fable 5.2 no longer show as missing. Usage tables and charts also consistently display its name as the concise `Fable 5.2`.

items.original: **Fable 5.2 has an offline price and a short name.** Costs for it no longer show as missing when the price table cannot be downloaded, and it appears as `Fable 5.2` in tables and charts.

title.zh-TW: --attach 憑證檢查延後至上傳端點並由伺服器裁定 GitHub App 權限
title.en: Defer `--attach` Credential Checks to Upload Endpoint and Let Server Arbitrate GitHub App Permissions

body.zh-TW: 在自動化流程中使用 GitHub CLI 發布內容時，若想隨附測試日誌或建置成品，通常會使用 `--attach` 參數打包檔案。⟦就像去快遞站寄送特殊包裹，以前臨櫃店員只要在清單上找不到對應代號就當場拒收，現在門市先將包裹轉交後端物流中心，由總部依照權限統一核對資格。⟧過去命令列工具會在終端機本機端提前檢查身分，容易直接攔下自動化工具的上傳請求。現在 GitHub CLI 將 `--attach` 的憑證檢查延後到上傳端點處理。GitHub 伺服器端會直接裁定哪些 GitHub App 的安裝權杖（token，向伺服器驗證身分的授權令牌）具備附加檔案的權限。使用 GitHub App 執行排程任務時，能否附加檔案，改由 GitHub 伺服器裁定；`--attach` 的憑證檢查則延後到上傳端點處理。
body.en: When publishing content in automated workflows using GitHub CLI, if you want to include test logs or build artifacts, you typically use the `--attach` flag to bundle files. ⟦Picture sending a special package at a courier station: counter clerks previously rejected parcels on the spot whenever a matching code was missing from their list, but now the station forwards packages to the backend logistics center so headquarters can centrally verify eligibility based on permissions.⟧ Previously, the command-line tool checked credentials early on the local terminal side, easily blocking upload requests from automated tools outright. Now, GitHub CLI defers `--attach` credential checks to the upload endpoint. The GitHub server directly arbitrates which GitHub App installation tokens (authorization credentials used to verify identity with the server) have permission to attach files. When running scheduled tasks with a GitHub App, whether files can be attached is decided by the GitHub server; `--attach` credential checks are deferred to the upload endpoint.

items.original:
Allow server to arbitrate which GitHub App installation tokens can attach files by @martinajir in [#14804](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14804)
Defer `--attach` credential checks to the upload endpoint by @BagToad in [#14805](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14805)
